summary: The hawkish June FOMC — where Chair Warsh's first press conference was widely interpreted as leaning hawkish and the updated projections showed the median policymaker expecting modest tightening by year-end — continues to anchor the week's tone.
tweet: Warsh's hawkish FOMC debut keeps rate-hike risk elevated while AI cost fears drag tech lower, splitting markets between defensive rotation and risk-off pressure across crypto and gold.
